hook.line: If you're new to TikTok, you need to know how to use Creator Search Insights.
hook.visual: Her face cut out over a screenshot of the Creator Search Insights page, 'How to get viral videos' title across the middle

beats.what: Green screen over the Creator Search Insights page with a 'How to get viral videos' title
Background swaps to the Content gap tab; she points up at the list of topics
Background swaps to a 'things worth buying' topic page with a search popularity chart
Explains the related-topics bubble: closer to the centre means more popular
Same background held while she explains where to put the keywords: title, description, hashtag
Wrap-up close to camera with a follow ask

why_it_works: Callout to new creators names the audience in the first line, so the right viewers self-select
The real tool on screen behind her is the proof; viewers can open the same page and follow along
Insider framing ('what TikTok wants to see more of') sells the content gap tab as a growth shortcut
weaknesses: Over two minutes with only five cuts and the same background held for the last 80 s
No running captions after the title, so it is hard to follow with sound off
She admits the screenshot is cut off and corrects herself mid-video; loose and unscripted
for_robert: Green screen over the real tool page is cheap proof; avoid holding one background for over a minute, swap it at each new idea.
